div.div:
auth service :8446
POST /auth/login -> cookie
POST /auth/token -> token
GET /auth/verify (Basic cached 5 min)
throttle: 5 per name, 50 per address
(address = last X-Forwarded-For hop,
client-controlled when direct: S-20)
signs with session.key (Ed25519)
8 hours; jti minted, never checked
sign-out deletes the cookie only (S-18)

div.div:
retail Postgres :5432
no certificate, ssl off
pg_hba (ldap_hba.sh:76-77):
host all reader,rolesync all scram
host nl2sql_retail +nl2sql_ldap all ldap
ldapserver=nl2sql-ldap ldaptls=1
host all all all scram (image's own)
the ldap method is AuthenticationCleartextPassword:
the client sends the password as typed

text.tspan: host all all all scram (image's own)
the client sends the password as typed

OpenLDAP (nl2sql-ldap) :389
StartTLS required for a simple bind
(security simple_bind=64)
Argon2 hash; lockout 5 / 900 s
replica: bind passed to the primary
(no StartTLS by default: S-23)

div.div: What is right: the browser's hop, the proxy's hop and the directory's hop are all TLS with the certificate verified; the session cannot be forged (fixed header, Ed25519, issuer and audience checked); a removed person is signed out within a minute. What is not: the one hop that carries the password as typed, auth service to Postgres, is plain TCP because the server has no certificate and sslmode=prefer accepts that silently -- and the same 'host ... ldap' rule answers a connection from anywhere on the network.

text.tspan: What is right: the browser's hop, the proxy's hop and the directory's hop are all TLS with the certificate verified; the session cannot be forged (fixed header, Ed25519, issuer and audience checked); a removed person is signed out within a minute. What is not: the one hop that carries the password as typed, auth service to Postgres, is
plain TCP because the server has no certificate and sslmode=prefer accepts that silently -- and the same 'host ... ldap' rule answers a connection from anywhere on the network.
